status: original proposals; not accepted or implemented
foundation_relevance: P5 is a design observation only; no verified King of Dragon Pass save-format compaction algorithm recovered.

packets.title: Forecast with a preparation window
packets.proposal: An original home-world weather rumor appears before a season. Player can reserve stores, shift routine work or ask a skilled neighbor; outcome records both choice and actual seasonal condition.
packets.acceptance: Prepare and abstain in two fresh runs; cross season boundary; food/work effects and a compact life entry agree; reload preserves prepared commitment.
packets.scope: One season, one home-world location, no required new origin.

packets.title: Companion availability has a cost
packets.proposal: A known artisan can travel on one short commission. Their local training is unavailable until return; another less skilled artisan can cover. Return or failure produces a persistent entry.
packets.acceptance: Dispatch prevents double booking and local service, return reopens it, save/reload retains assignment and due time.

packets.title: Favor ledger with imperfect public knowledge
packets.proposal: Track signed small obligations between player and one original NPC; giving aid reduces existing opposing debt first. Gossip reports reputation separately from the precise balance.
packets.acceptance: Opposing help nets debt, collecting changes resources once, overheard account never overwrites the true ledger.

packets.title: Delayed apprenticeship and succession
packets.proposal: Invite one apprentice whose arrival waits on a household condition. Existing mentor reacts to promised support; years of routine learning can unlock a teaching role before any death mechanic.
packets.acceptance: Pending invitation survives reload; apprentice arrives once; support cost and mentor reaction persist; vanilla skill use remains available.

packets.title: Event response plus compact remembered aftermath
packets.proposal: For one original dispute store eligibility, committed choice and a scheduled follow-up as separate IDs; preserve only meaningful annual life records rather than all transient prose.
packets.acceptance: Reload cannot reroll the committed choice; follow-up executes once after time advance; compaction retains participant, decision and outcome linkage.

exclusions: No mandatory clan system or new runtime writer
No numeric threshold borrowed from native aging
